description:
In this vlog, me and my Bengali cousin went on an amazing trip to Tanguar Haor in Sylhet and stayed on the beautiful Fantasy Houseboat! 🌊🚤

We cruised through the peaceful waters, enjoyed breathtaking views, laughed a lot, and made beautiful memories. The houseboat experience was super relaxing, and Tanguar Haor truly felt like a hidden gem of Bangladesh.

📍 What you'll see in this video:
– Our Fantasy Houseboat tour
– The calm and scenic beauty of Tanguar Haor
– Fun cousin moments and lots of smiles
– Nature, water, and adventure!
